sources.entry: Bracket - Flexible tournament system to build a tournament setup, add teams, schedule matches, keep track of scores and present ranking live to the public. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Bracket is a self-hostable tournament management system written in async Python (FastAPI) with a Vite/Mantine frontend.
summary.what_it_does: Bracket lets you build a tournament structure with multiple stages, each containing groups or brackets, in single elimination, round-robin, or swiss formats. You can create and update teams, add players to teams, and drag-and-drop matches onto different courts or reschedule their start times. It provides public-facing dashboard pages that can be customized with a logo, and supports multiple clubs with multiple tournaments per club. Swiss tournaments can be handled dynamically with automatic match scheduling. The README also mentions multilingual UI, with language auto-detected from browser settings and translations managed through Crowdin.
use_cases: Organize a single elimination or round-robin sports tournament
Run a swiss-format competition with automatic match scheduling
Schedule matches across courts and start times
Publish live tournament rankings and dashboards to the public
Manage multiple clubs and tournaments from one instance
Track team rosters and match scores
how_to_run: docker exec bracket-backend uv run --no-dev ./cli.py create-dev-db (optional: insert dummy data)
notable: Supports single elimination, round-robin and swiss tournament formats
Drag-and-drop match scheduling across courts and times
Public live ranking and dashboard pages with custom logo
Multiple clubs, each with multiple tournaments
Configurable via .env files or environment variables
caveats: Public demo data is deleted after 30 minutes
Docker quickstart requires PostgreSQL alongside backend and frontend; manual setup needs pnpm, postgresql and uv
Translations are auto-detected from browser language with no manual language picker
